item.title: More than $1,000 raised for pets in need with Santa photo shoot

item.title: Elementary pupils cheer on Olympic athlete mentor as part of Classroom Champions program
item.description: Students held a cheer party for luge athlete Devin Wardrope on Tuesday, February 3rd at Pouce Coupe Elementary. He has been mentoring them through the Classroom Champions program.

item.title: Call for local artists to submit designs for 2026 city banners
item.description: The City of Fort St. John is collaborating with the FSJ Arts Council to host a workshop for local artists to create banners for 2026.

item.title: Fort St. John’s water main leak discovered in December, emergency plan in place if repairs overrun
item.description: Repairs to Fort St. John's feeder water main are scheduled to begin on February 5th, which city officials say allowed time to secure specialized materials.

item.title: Environment Canada issues freezing rain warning for Fort Nelson
item.description: Environment Canada warns a warm front passing through Fort Nelson beginning on the afternoon of February 3rd could “bring periods of ice pellets or freezing rain.”
